policy.method: Normal scene depth. Service markings follow each route physical profile with small support clearance. Overhead surfaces beyond a 0.65 m local support window are not used to raise a lower route.
policy.viewerDepthPolicy: depthTest=true; depthWrite=true; renderOrder=0; opaque unlit system colour; ordinary scene occlusion.
policy.renderPolicy: All service guides remain in the same scene and camera depth as buildings and terrain. No separate Alpha Over route scene.
policy.underpasses: Tracks or markings below an overhead bridge, station roof, building, or terrain are intentionally hidden. This is physical occlusion, not a broken route.
policy.scopeCaveat: Source profiles remain approximate. Exact engineering levels, inferred HML counterpart tracks and switch geometry are not certified.
